verdict.rationale: Hosted-cloud offload with published pricing, rate limits, and usage caps is a fair question for local inference runtimes, since peers can offer such tiers. LocalAI's evidence describes only a self-hosted runtime (localhost API, distributed self-registered worker nodes, per-user usage tracking on your own deployment). Nothing documents a vendor-hosted cloud tier or its pricing, limits, or caps.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know the pricing tiers, rate limits, and usage caps that apply when offloading inference to the vendor's hosted cloud tier
